verdict.rationale: Cline's docs describe building features through natural conversation and coordinated multi-file changes with linter-aware fixes, diffs, checkpoints and undo. They also give plain-language fix examples such as "run tests and fix failures" and "fix the layout issue", and hands-on users report setting it loose on a codebase with diffs that are "almost always completely on the money". Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the multi-file editing workflow beyond marketing-level claims.
